info.title: Pmad.CodeCondenser.Cli
info.description: Roslyn-based static analysis CLI tool to detect C# code clones and condense verbose comments via local LLMs.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Static analysis tool for C# clone detection and comment summarization

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

options.name: --apply
options.description: Write shortened comments directly to source files [default: False]

options.name: --incremental
options.description: Use snapshot cache to analyze only modified or new files [default: False]

options.name: --update-snapshot
options.description: Refresh the snapshot baseline [default: False]

options.name: --no-color
options.description: Disable ANSI color formatting [default: False]

options.name: --no-comments
options.description: Disable comment extraction and summarization (alias for --summary disabled) [default: False]

options.name: --enable-comments
options.description: Explicitly enable comment summarization [default: False]

options.name: --report-only
options.description: Report-only mode for comments without calling an LLM [default: False]

options.name: --summary
options.description: Comment summary mode: disabled, summarize, or report

options.name: --no-duplication
options.description: Disable structural code clone detection [default: False]

options.name: --enable-duplication
options.description: Explicitly enable code clone detection [default: False]

options.name: --no-strings
options.description: Disable repeated inline string detection [default: False]

options.name: --enable-strings
options.description: Explicitly enable repeated inline string detection [default: False]

options.name: --exclude-tests
options.description: Completely exclude test files [default: False]

options.name: --enforce-test-duplication
options.description: Treat test clones as CI policy violation in gate check [default: False]

options.name: --include-generated
options.description: Disable automatic exclusion of generated files [default: False]

options.name: --sub-method-clones
options.description: Enable sliding-window sub-method clone detection [default: False]

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Preview actions without modifying files on disk [default: False]

options.name: --force
options.description: Force overwrite skill files even if up to date [default: False]

options.name: --clean
options.description: Remove obsolete files from skill directories [default: False]

options.name: --duplication-tolerance
options.description: Maximum new clone clusters tolerated in incremental mode

options.name: --comment-tolerance
options.description: Maximum new verbose comments tolerated in incremental mode

options.name: --string-tolerance
options.description: Maximum new repeated string groups tolerated in incremental mode

options.name: --threshold-statements
options.description: Minimum statements for clone detection

options.name: --threshold-comments
options.description: Minimum character length for verbose comments

options.name: --threshold-strings
options.description: Minimum character length for repeated string detection (default: 100)

options.name: --string-occurrences
options.description: Minimum occurrences for repeated string detection (default: 2)

options.name: --threshold-xml-summary
options.description: Minimum content length for XML summary/remarks

options.name: --threshold-xml-param
options.description: Minimum content length for XML param

options.name: --threshold-submethod-statements
options.description: Minimum statements for sub-method clone detection

options.name: --context-size
options.description: Specify context window size in tokens

options.name: --max-line-length
options.description: Maximum line length for formatted comments

options.name: --model

options.name: --max-retries

options.name: --estimator

options.name: --endpoint

options.name: --config

options.name: --global-config

options.name: --no-global-config

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format: console, sarif, json

options.name: --skill
